name: iris09

source_checkout.scope: Checkout context; bound project, native and renderer hashes identify actual inputs

consumer_path.proof: Observed shared builder call/return; identical returned geometry/material buffers; verified and frozen recorded-state holder

runtime_implementation.capture: Source files and package versions observed at causal_runtime module import; not the complete Python import closure

replay_check.scope: Every recorded body matrix matches the trace; active replay uses the verified shared preceding-state holder. No continuous clearance claim.

native_source.upstream_license: No license grant supplied; adaptation requested by the source owner for CYBR GEO. No upstream license is inferred.
native_source.input_spec_hash_encoding: physical_model.digest: sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON; no numeric rounding
native_source.scope: New rigid pinned-link mechanism derived from source optical geometry; no hardware qualification
assumptions: New derived four-bar mechanism; the source has no inherited mechanical transmission or dynamics
One scene unit is assumed to be 50 mm; materials and motor values are engineering assumptions
Source foil thickness is 0.0325 mm; its manufacturing and tolerance stack are unqualified
Pinned joints use ideal axes with nominal CAD bores; bearing contact, flexibility, fatigue and wear are not modeled
Grooved split retainers have nominal CAD capture and clearance; elastic installation and retention strength are unqualified
Rotor capture lips retain 0.3 mm nominal thickness with an envelope-derived axial fit; their strength and deflection are unqualified
Joint limits are model travel guards, not a claim of physical stop hardware
Annular direct-drive DC torque port is a lumped actuator assumption with a fixed reaction housing, not a selected supplier motor
All nine follower leaves move through rod forces; only the annular rotor has a motor
